topics.name: Service Mapping Pattern Design
topics.description: Pattern Designer operations, steps, temp variables, command line console, parsing strategies, WMI/SSH/SNMP scripting, regex, and application identification sections

introduction.overview: Service Mapping Pattern Design covers the core technical skills needed to create, modify, and troubleshoot discovery patterns. This domain represents 30% of the CIS-SM exam and focuses on understanding how patterns identify and map application services.
introduction.keyConcepts: Pattern Designer interface, debug mode, pattern steps, temp variables, parse operations, WMI/SSH/SNMP probing, regex for parsing, application identification sections, and connection sections in patterns.

topics.name: Service Mapping Configuration
topics.description: Setup and configuration files, tuning, entry points, CI types, credentials, service maps, schedules, service groups, and technical services

introduction.overview: Service Mapping Configuration covers the administrative setup and configuration of Service Mapping including entry points, credentials, service groups, and access control. This domain represents 20% of the CIS-SM exam.
introduction.keyConcepts: Entry point configuration, CI types and classification, credentials management, service maps and relationships, discovery schedules, service groups, technical services, roles and permissions.

topics.name: Discovery Configuration
topics.description: Discovery behaviors, clusters, IP services, schedules, MID servers, PCIE phases, ECC queue, and troubleshooting authentication errors

introduction.overview: Discovery Configuration covers the setup and troubleshooting of Discovery components that support Service Mapping. This domain represents 15% of the CIS-SM exam and focuses on MID Server configuration, discovery schedules, and error handling.
introduction.keyConcepts: MID Server setup and validation, discovery behaviors, clusters, IP services and ranges, discovery schedules, PCIE phases, ECC queue, authentication errors, error categorization and bulk fixing.

topics.name: Machine Learning
topics.description: Service Mapping methods guidance, ML-powered mapping, Service Mapping Workspace, and mapping service candidates

introduction.overview: Machine Learning covers intelligent service mapping capabilities including tag-based mapping, Predictive Intelligence, and the Service Mapping Workspace. This domain represents 10% of the CIS-SM exam.
introduction.keyConcepts: Tag-based mapping, Service Mapping Workspace, Predictive Intelligence for connection suggestions, service candidates, automated service discovery, comparing mapping methods.

topics.name: Configuration Management Database
topics.description: CI Class Manager, CMDB Health Dashboard, tables, reclassification, identification rules, reconciliation rules, and de-duplication tasks

introduction.overview: CMDB Integration covers how Service Mapping interacts with the CMDB including CI relationships, discovery patterns, and data storage. This domain represents 15% of the CIS-SM exam.
introduction.keyConcepts: CI Class Manager, CMDB tables and relationships, CI reclassification, identification and reconciliation rules, datasource precedence, de-duplication tasks, cloud database CIs.

topics.name: Service Mapping Engagement Readiness
topics.description: Service definition, shared services, licensing, MID server requirements, implementation planning, security requirements, and measurable KPIs

introduction.overview: Engagement Readiness covers planning and preparation for Service Mapping implementations including prerequisites, credentials, and service organization. This domain represents 10% of the CIS-SM exam.
introduction.keyConcepts: Host and applicative credentials, sudo-level Unix permissions, service definition and organization, review and approval workflows, segment transfer, generic application identification.
